query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as records_last_7_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cardId) as cards_with_data
FROM priceHistory 
WHERE source = 'snkrdunk' 
  AND soldAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
